entries.prompt:
Photoreal teaching display, TWO horizontal panoramic photographs STACKED vertically (one column,two rows). Overall aspect4:3, ideally2048x1536. Each photograph8:3. No gutters. LEFT diagram H2O: ONE red oxygen, TWO white hydrogens belowleft/right, clearly BENT. Two blue lone-pair lobes above O, each EXACTLY TWO dark dots.
